title: fix(scripts): correct the RETIRED_FIELD_TYPES `excluded` sentence that dropping the line refutes (objectui#10070)
body:
Fixes #10070

Clause-②: no — a comment in a source file; no accept set or public contract surface moves

## What was false, and where it actually lives

The sentence objectui#9803 corrected on the `RETIRED_DASHBOARD_NODE_TYPES` entry has a twin on the `RETIRED_FIELD_TYPES` entry of `INDIRECT_REGISTRATIONS` in `scripts/check-doc-component-types.mjs`, in that entry's `excluded` string. Before this change it read:

> Deciding it either way flips one switch and nothing else — DROP this `excluded` line and the collection's keys (today `field:owner`) enter the universe, so a document teaching `field:owner` turns GREEN; keep it and such a document stays RED, which is what happens today.

The corrected copy on the dashboard entry reads, in part: "DROPPING this `excluded` line does NOT re-admit `view:dashboard` — … it makes THIS entry report `stale-indirect-registration`". The field entry's own `reason` already stated the cause: "RETIRED_FIELD_TYPES is IMPORTED into this file from `@object-ui/core`, so nothing here could read it anyway."

⚠️ **The fix is not in the file the dispatch expected.** The dispatch expected the sentence in the `RETIRED_FIELD_TYPES` docblock in `packages/core/src/utils/retired-field-types.ts`. That docblock has no copy of it: the only matches for "flips one switch", "enter the universe" and "turns GREEN" in the tracked tree are in the gate script's entry. The card's own description ("the same entry's `reason` half") points at the gate-table entry, and this PR edits that entry. `packages/core` is untouched.

## The change

The false sentence is replaced with one sentence stating what dropping the line does, and naming the two commands that re-derive it. The rest of the entry is unchanged: the `WITHHELD` question and the whole `reason` field stay as they are. The diff touches one file, +7 −3.

The text is the only thing that changes. The derivation checks `excluded` only for truthiness (`typeof entry.excluded === 'string' && entry.excluded.length > 0`), and the string is still non-empty. No key, collection, namespace or site changes, and no other entry changes.

## Measured before the sentence was written, and again on the committed fix

Both runs deleted the entry's `excluded` property with objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. That tool requires the anchor to match, checks the mutation on disk, and restores the file afterwards, proving the restore with `git diff HEAD`. Each run used a lit probe doc under `content/docs/`: one block teaching `field:owner` and one teaching `field:user`. The probe was removed by a trap.

| reading | unmutated | `excluded` dropped |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pnpm check:doc-types` | exit 0 | exit 1: `packages/fields/src/index.tsx (RETIRED_FIELD_TYPES) [stale-indirect-registration]` |
| `node scripts/regenerate-known-schema-types.mjs --check` | exit 0 | exit 1, same finding, "nothing was written" |
| derived universe size | 648 | 648 |
| `packages/cli/src/utils/known-schema-types.ts` blob | `3447617c5d` | `3447617c5d` |
| probe doc teaching `field:owner` | RED, `unregistered-doc-type` | RED, `unregistered-doc-type` plus the stale finding |
| lit control `field:user` in the same probe | counted registered | counted registered |

Base run on `06a96e9480`, re-run on `c9d3b58b50` (this PR's commit). In both runs the mutated file hashed to the same blob, `587fcde4ffb9`, so the sentence text has no effect on what the ablation measures. Every restore ended with blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

⚠️ The first ablation attempt was a no-op. `ablation-replace` refused it because the replacement text was a substring of the anchor, restored the file and ran nothing. The run was repeated in `--delete` mode with an exact anchor. That second run is the one reported above.

## Verification at `c9d3b58b50`

Exit codes were captured to a file before any pipe.

- `pnpm check:doc-types` exit 0 ("Every documented component type is registered."). `node scripts/regenerate-known-schema-types.mjs --check` exit 0.
- `pnpm check:control-bytes` exit 0. `pnpm check:new-line-citations` exit 0 (`VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`).
- `pnpm check:prompt-keys` exit 0 and `pnpm check:registry-bare-names` exit 0. Both import `INDIRECT_REGISTRATIONS` or its derivation.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` exit 0: "No source or published contract of a released package changed in this range, so no changeset is owed." No changeset is added.
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test scripts/check-doc-component-types.mjs` answers NOT GOVERNED.
- Tests, run from the repo root through the shared verify lock: every test file that `git grep`s `check-doc-component-types`, plus `scripts/__tests__/registry-bare-name-collisions.test.ts`. The result is **26 files, 1404 tests passed** (`VERDICT command-exit 0`).
- Dispatch-named, run although the diff does not touch `@object-ui/core`: the `@object-ui/core` dependency closure was built, then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/core type-check` exited 0 (the script echoed `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`). `packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/retired-field-types.test.ts` passed 9 of 9.
- Lint: `pnpm exec eslint scripts/check-doc-component-types.mjs --format json` judged 1 file with 0 errors and 0 warnings. ⚠️ This is a parse check only. `eslint --print-config` for this file shows 0 enabled rules and the `espree` parser with no type-aware parser options, so this diff cannot change any other file's lint verdict. The full `pnpm lint` run is left to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- Not changed here, noted for whoever next edits `INDIRECT_REGISTRATIONS`: the same `excluded` string still opens with "WITHHELD pending objectui#9717, which is open on exactly this question". objectui#9717 was closed as completed on 2026-09-20 under ruling letter A: retired spellings stay out of the universe. The same stale "open question" wording appears in the `RETIRED_DASHBOARD_NODE_TYPES` entry's `excluded` text. A comment in `scripts/__tests__/check-doc-component-types.test.ts` also says "while objectui#9717 is open". The withheld disposition is still correct; only the status wording is out of date. That is a separate sentence from the one this card names, so it is left untouched.
- The card body refers to "the triage comment on this card" for its re-measurement. At the time of this PR, the card's thread holds only the claim comment. The measurement above was taken fresh.

Seat session, in prose so it survives an edit: `https://claude.ai/code/session_01EBx9rvB7dufCz4at53x35U`.
